001package edu.pdx.cs.joy.whitlock;
002
003import edu.pdx.cs.joy.lang.Human;
004import org.jspecify.annotations.NonNull;
005
006import java.util.ArrayList;
007import java.util.Arrays;
008
009/**
010 * This class represents a <code>Student</code>.
011 */
012public class Student extends Human {
013
014  private final double gpa;
015  private final ArrayList<String> classes;
016  private final Gender gender;
017
018  /**
019   * Creates a new <code>Student</code>
020   *
021   * @param name
022   *        The student's name
023   * @param classes
024   *        The names of the classes the student is taking.  A student
025   *        may take zero or more classes.
026   * @param gpa
027   *        The student's grade point average
028   * @param gender
029   *        The student's gender ("male", "female", or "other", case-insensitive)
030   */
031  public Student(String name, ArrayList<String> classes, double gpa, String gender) {
032    super(name);
033    this.classes = classes;
034    this.gender = getGenderFor(gender);
035
036    if (gpa < 0.0 || gpa > 4.0) {
037      throw new InvalidGPAException(gpa);
038    }
039
040    this.gpa = gpa;
041  }
042
043  private Gender getGenderFor(String gender) {
044    if (gender.equalsIgnoreCase("Female")) {
045      return Gender.FEMALE;
046
047    } else if (gender.equalsIgnoreCase("Male")) {
048      return Gender.MALE;
049
050    } else if (gender.equalsIgnoreCase("Other")) {
051      return Gender.OTHER;
052
053    } else {
054      throw new UnsupportedGenderException(gender);
055    }
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * All students say "This class is too much work"
060   */
061  @Override
062  public String says() {
063    return "This class is too much work";
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Returns a <code>String</code> that describes this
068   * <code>Student</code>.
069   */
070  public String toString() {
071    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder()
072      .append(this.getName())
073      .append(" has a GPA of ")
074      .append(this.gpa)
075      .append(" and is taking ")
076      .append(getClassesDescription()).append("  ")
077      .append(getPronoun()).append(" say");
078    if (this.gender == Gender.FEMALE || this.gender == Gender.MALE) {
079      sb.append("s");
080    }
081    sb.append(" \"");
082    sb.append(this.says());
083    sb.append("\".");
084    return sb.toString();
085  }
086
087  private @NonNull String getClassesDescription() {
088    int numberOfClasses = this.classes.size();
089    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder().append(numberOfClasses);
090    sb.append(" class");
091    if (numberOfClasses == 0) {
092      sb.append("es");
093
094    } else if (numberOfClasses == 1) {
095      sb.append(": ");
096      sb.append(classes.getFirst());
097
098    } else if (numberOfClasses == 2) {
099      sb.append("es: ");
100      sb.append(classes.getFirst());
101      sb.append(" and ");
102      sb.append(classes.getLast());
103
104    } else {
105      sb.append("es: ");
106
107      for (int i = 0; i < numberOfClasses; i++) {
108        sb.append(classes.get(i));
109        if (i < numberOfClasses - 1) {
110          sb.append(", ");
111        }
112        if (i == numberOfClasses - 2) {
113          sb.append("and ");
114        }
115      }
116    }
117
118    sb.append('.');
119    return sb.toString();
120  }
121
122  /**
123   * Main program that parses the command line, creates a
124   * <code>Student</code>, and prints a description of the student to
125   * standard out by invoking its <code>toString</code> method.
126   */
127  public static void main(String[] args) {
128    if (args.length == 0) {
129      System.err.println("Missing name");
130      return;
131    }
132
133    if (args.length == 1) {
134      System.err.println("Missing gender");
135      return;
136    }
137
138    if (args.length == 2) {
139      System.err.println("Missing GPA");
140      return;
141    }
142
143    String name = args[0];
144    String gender = args[1];
145    double gpa;
146    try {
147      gpa = Double.parseDouble(args[2]);
148
149    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
150      System.err.println("Invalid GPA: " + args[2] + ".  GPA must be a number.");
151      return;
152    }
153
154    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(args).subList(3, args.length));
155
156    Student student;
157    try {
158      student = new Student(name, classes, gpa, gender);
159
160    } catch (InvalidGPAException e) {
161      System.err.println("Invalid GPA: " + e.getInvalidGPA() + ".  Valid GPAS are in the range of 0.0-4.0");
162      return;
163
164    } catch (UnsupportedGenderException e) {
165      System.err.println("Unsupported Gender: " + e.getUnsupportedGender());
166      return;
167    }
168    System.out.println(student);
169  }
170
171  public String getPronoun() {
172    return switch (this.gender) {
173      case FEMALE -> "She";
174      case MALE -> "He";
175      case OTHER -> "They";
176    };
177  }
178}
